claims.text: All mapped facility routes are lost if candidate-exposed edges are impassable.
A mapped route remains under candidate-edge removal. Passability is not verified.
Settlement snapping or mapped facility coverage is unavailable.

limitations: Candidate exposure is not confirmed damage, bridge failure or road closure.
Backscatter-change scores are heuristic, not calibrated flood probabilities.
Steep DEM slopes are masked; full radar layover/shadow modeling is not implemented.
Optical corroboration unavailable; candidate results are SAR-only.
Brightening is a candidate disturbance layer, not validated debris segmentation.
Road graph uses geometric noding; OSM turn restrictions and node-ID semantics are not fully represented.
Road access is assessed within the requested AOI, not the entire regional network.
Only mapped vehicle-access roads and facilities are considered; apparent cuts at the AOI boundary can be artifacts.
DEM acquired_at is the server retrieval time, not an original elevation survey date.
Synthetic geographic training data; no real finding about this area.
